==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Serge:''' Maybe adding a bit more crimson here will make it look fancier. But... would it still perfectly highlight my style?
:'''Serge:''' Hmm... what can I do to make it more interesting?
:{{DIcon}} What's bothering you?
:'''Serge:''' My costume and mask designs were rejected by the Masked Reverie. Nyarla is so harsh...
:'''Serge:''' You see, it's utterly disrespectful to attend the Carnevale without the perfect outfit.
:'''Serge:''' Besides, I have to dress to impress so that my handsome face leaves a lasting impression on everyone.
:{{DIcon}} ...Why did Nyarla reject your design?
:'''Serge:''' She said that simply having Shell Credits isn't enough to make someone a customer at her shop.
:'''Serge:''' She requires an engaging character and extraordinary artistic vision to spark her creative passion.
:'''Serge:''' My my... all those harsh words. She was implying that I was too ordinary for her taste!
:{{DIcon}} Why don't you try another shop?
:'''Serge:''' No way! Nyarla is the best, and no one has her eye for detail! If I go to someone else for a custom design, I'd be at a disadvantage before the Carnevale even begins!
:'''Serge:''' She gave me a ton of feedback on the character designs and style guides. Just wait and see—I'll find a way to impress her!
{{Dialogue End}}
